### Key Action Items & Recommendations

* **Hunter Target (Level 71 → 83):** Continuing toward your 83 Hunter target (unlocking [Herby Werby](https://runescape.wiki/w/Herby_Werby) bonuses and high-level creatures). Check out the [Hunter Training Guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Hunter_training) for optimal XP rates (e.g., Azure Skillchinchompas or Jadinkos).
* **Slayer & Necromancy Synergy:** With 95 [Slayer](https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer) and your [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet), your 106 Necromancy allows you to breeze through top-tier Slayer tasks for fast combat XP and gold.
* **Support Skill Goals:**
  * **[Herblore](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Herblore_training) (75):** Push toward level 96 for [Overload](https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload) potions to maximize your bossing/slayer potential.
  * **[Invention](https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_training) (48):** Levelling Invention will allow you to perk your Necromancy weapons and armor for major damage boosts.

Whenever you're ready to dive back into strategy, just say the word!
